title: Reusable examples and translation lifecycle
summary: Add shared project examples and non-blocking, hash-bound translation tracking, then adopt both capabilities in ui-doc and the English Docara skill.
done_when: Shared examples are confined, receipted, dependency-aware and compatible with inline examples.
Translation status and hash-bound acceptance cover pages and lang.json without mutating authored sources during status or build.
ui-doc migrates the imported examples, enables Russian-source reporting and verifies its complete static site.
The English skill, graph, documentation and project memory describe the same verified contract.
scope: English Docara skill and project technology context
non_goals: Silent matching of ambiguous locale pages
Commit, push, tag, release, package publication or deploy
evidence_policy: Build and translation status must not change Markdown or the translation lock.
Historical workflow and evidence remain immutable and may only be superseded by current routing.
Completion requires product, consumer, skill and graph verification.
